name: Alors on Danse AI
blurb: Two pet photos in: they make the beat in the studio, then dance off.

prompts.label: Template prompt
prompts.text: Two reference photos, one animal each. The animal in the FIRST photo stands on the LEFT; the animal in the SECOND photo stands on the RIGHT. Keep each animal exactly as photographed: same species, breed, fur or feathers, markings and face, and never swap them. Both stand upright at a small white desk in a bare, seamless white photo studio, with a compact black mini keyboard and an open silver laptop on the desk. The left one taps out a beat on the keys with its paws while the right one nods along, points at the screen and throws a paw up in excitement; then one of them leans right into the lens with a wide-eyed face. To finish, both leave the desk and run toward the camera side by side across the empty white floor, dancing in step. Real animal anatomy: paws, claws or wings, never human hands. Locked-off eye-level camera, soft even studio light, one continuous take, vertical video. Upbeat electro-house beat in the audio. No people, no text, no logos, no watermark.
